name: Bata India Ltd
title: Bata India Ltd - 500043 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Bata's 2QFY27 growth of 7.5% was ASP-led (5-6% ASP, volume only marginal) with no capacity signal; margins guided range-bound and the doubling-by-2030 ambition has no numeric year-by-year path.

summary.headline: Bata India 2QFY27 turnover grew 7.5% to 8.6 million (fourth straight positive quarter), with growth largely ASP-led and gross margin up only 8-10 bps reported.
summary.overview: Bata India reported 2QFY27 turnover of 8.6 million units-as-stated, up 7.5% YoY and the fourth consecutive quarter of positive growth, driven mainly by ASP rather than volume. Management said adjusted PBT grew over 31% YoY and adjusted operating cash profit grew over 9%, helped by inventory discipline (stock turn above 2.6, aged inventory near 5%) and lower markdowns. Growth was held back by the festive calendar shifting into 3Q, deferred e-commerce orders from selected B2B partners, and a channel mix shift toward lower-margin distribution, e-commerce and franchise. New CEO Sanjay Rao, on his first call, set a target to double India turnover and profit by 2030 and flagged new global product lines for 2H FY27.

financial_highlights.change: +8-10 bps QoQ (Sanjay Rao first cited ~70 bps, then corrected)

financial_highlights.metric: Gross margin on similar channel mix

segments.name: Franchisee and I&D channels
segments.commentary: Management reported double-digit growth in franchisee and I&D channels. I&D grew in mid-teens with strong secondary sales growth.

segments.name: E-commerce
segments.commentary: E-commerce grew at a healthy pace despite deferment of orders from selected B2B partners. Lower-ASP e-com volumes are expected to shift into 3Q with the festive calendar.

segments.name: Premium brands (Floatz, HP)
segments.commentary: Premium brands such as Floatz and HP are growing faster and are cited as the main driver of ASP growth. No figures were disclosed.

guidance_outlook: Ambition to double India turnover by 2030 (Reignite India 2030), implying mid-single-digit to double-digit CAGR over the next 4 years; management endeavours to reach mid-teens growth.
Profit ambition: at least double profit, with management indicating something higher than that to fund investments; more precise profit guidance to come later.

Gross margin expected to be range-bound, with ASP tailwind offset by channel mix shift toward franchise, distribution and e-commerce; management remains cautious on gross margin expansion given commodity and currency volatility.
ASP price increase of 5-6% taken in September, flowing through from 1Q-end inventory cycle of about 5-6 months; impact expected to show from next quarter (3Q).
Plans for double-digit new store openings in the coming year, mainly franchisee and selective COCO, with relocations and renovations; management says it has no intent to cannibalise existing stores.
New global product lines, including sneakers, expected to arrive largely in 2H FY27; no launch date given.
capex_capacity: Store availability up 1.33x vs last year; store clutter at 0.71x of levels two years ago, per management.
Plans to open double-digit new stores in the coming year (franchise-led, with selective COCO); relocations and renovations also planned.
Sneaker push: sneaker contribution currently below management's desired level; focus brands Bata and Hush Puppies; details promised at next quarterly results.
Global product pipeline reviewed on a trip abroad; launch timing not disclosed.
demand_pricing: Turnover up 7.5% YoY, with growth largely ASP-led and volume growing only marginally; management said SSG was positive with 'good single-digit' growth (exact figure not given).
ASP up in the 5-6% range, driven by premiumisation and a 5-6% price increase taken in September. CFO said the price impact is not yet visible in 2Q because of inventory lag.
Footfall grew in stores while the broader market faced headwinds. Early October-November trends are positive, with festive demand shifted from 2Q to 3Q (Durga Puja and Diwali).
Consumers are trading up in price points; low-priced products are selling below higher price points, per management.
Competition is intensifying: nimbler and larger competitors have entered over the past decade, and the sneaker category is a gap for Bata.
Ad spend up over 4% on a half-year basis; management is rightsizing marketing toward community building and ROI.

qa_highlights.question: What is the split between SSG volume growth and ASP, and how much ASP comes from the 5-6% September price hike?
qa_highlights.answer: Management would not give exact SSG numbers but said SSG was positive with good single-digit growth. ASP is up 5-6%, growth is largely ASP-led with marginal volume growth, and the price hike impact will only show from next quarter.

qa_highlights.question: What are footfall and secondary trends in October and early November given the festive shift to 3Q?
qa_highlights.answer: Footfall is positive despite market headwinds, and trends into November are positive. Management declined to share details ahead of the last weekend before Diwali.

qa_highlights.question: Will gross margins keep improving, and is there any low-cost inventory benefit?
qa_highlights.answer: Reported gross margin rose only 8-10 bps QoQ due to channel mix dilution. On a similar channel mix, expansion would be about 70-80 bps, from fewer markdowns and fresh-inventory sales. Management will stay cautious given commodity and currency volatility.

qa_highlights.question: When will volume growth reach high-single or mid-single digits, and what brand-led initiatives are planned?
qa_highlights.answer: Volume gains are expected from 3Q as e-commerce events shift into that quarter. New product lines are due mainly in 2H FY27, and the sneaker push focuses on Bata and Hush Puppies.

qa_highlights.question: What growth target is set for the next few years, and are margins at the bottom?
qa_highlights.answer: Target is to double India turnover by 2030, implying mid-single to double-digit CAGR. Management says margins will stay range-bound, with ASP gains offset by channel mix shifts toward franchise.

qa_highlights.question: Is the decade-long underperformance internal or external, and will profit double alongside revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called it a mix of internal and external factors, citing product gaps and slow agility to sneakerisation as internal, and currency and global volatility as external. It said profit should at least double alongside turnover, possibly more.

risks_watch: Gross margin pressure from channel mix shift toward franchise, distribution and e-commerce, plus commodity and currency volatility.
Whether the 5-6% price hike sticks and volume recovers in 3Q given the festive shift and deferred B2B e-commerce orders.
Brand relevance with younger consumers and the timing and reception of new global and sneaker product lines.
Ad spend efficiency: management is rightsizing spend while growth needs brand investment.
Delivery of the 2030 doubling target, given a decade of subdued top-line and PBT growth and management's refusal to give a precise profit guide.
Competitive intensity from larger and nimbler entrants.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating execution (availability, inventory, franchise growth) and the new product pipeline, but cautious on gross margin and profit guidance, citing commodity, currency and global volatility. Evasive on SSG numbers, brand-specific metrics and store-level detail, and the call was short on quantified figures.
key_quotes: We recorded a turnover of 8.6 million for the quarter, recording a growth of 7.5% and maintaining the positive trajectory for the fourth consecutive quarter.
So we are committed to keep the margin range bound, while there would be slight changes based on the channel mix that we will have.
So we are looking at at least that, Sudhir. So our position is to maintain sustainable and profitable growth.

adds.what: Double-digit new store openings in the coming year (franchise-led, selective COCO), plus relocations and renovations

growth.why: Management reiterated a 2030 ambition to double India turnover (mid-single to double-digit CAGR) and plans double-digit new store openings next year, but no specific capacity, orders or contracts are quantified; 2QFY27 turnover grew 7.5% largely on ASP, with a 5-6% price increase flowing from 3Q and new product lines only expected in 2H FY27 without launch dates.

mgmt.note: Sanjay Rao, new CEO on his first call, set a target to double India turnover and profit by 2030 (Reignite India 2030).
initiatives: Double India turnover by 2030 (mid-teens growth ambition)
Double-digit new store openings next year, franchise-led with selective COCO
New global product lines including sneakers in 2H FY27

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Reported gross margin up only 8-10 bps QoQ on channel-mix dilution, but management estimates ~70-80 bps expansion on similar mix from fewer markdowns, and management guides gross margin range-bound given commodity and currency volatility.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Management guided double-digit new store openings in the coming year (franchise-led, selective COCO) plus relocations and renovations, but no store count, capex amount or utilisation figure was given.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: 2QFY27 turnover grew 7.5% mostly on ASP with volume only marginal; management expects volume gains from 3Q as festive e-commerce orders shift in, and early Oct-Nov trends are positive, but no volume figure was disclosed.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex was not discussed and no utilisation figure was given; store openings are franchise-led and not quantified as capex.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management stayed cautious on gross margin and gave no precise profit guidance, citing commodity, currency and global volatility; the only firm target is the 2030 doubling ambition, which was held rather than raised.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Growth was held back by festive timing, deferred B2B e-commerce orders and channel mix shift toward lower-margin distribution, and SSG was only 'good single-digit' with volume marginal, so the 3Q recovery needs to materialise.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management said new global product lines, including sneakers, are expected largely in 2H FY27 with focus brands Bata and Hush Puppies, though no launch date was given and sneaker contribution is currently below desired levels.

rows.label: 5-6% ASP price increase flowing through
rows.why: A 5-6% price increase was taken in September and flows from the 5-6 month inventory cycle, so the impact is expected to show from next quarter (3Q).

rows.label: Premium brands Floatz and HP driving ASP
rows.why: Management cited Floatz and HP as growing faster and as the main ASP driver, with ASP up 5-6%, though no segment figures were disclosed.

rows.label: Reignite India 2030: double turnover and profit
rows.why: Ambition to double India turnover by 2030 implies mid-single to double-digit CAGR and at least doubled profit, but management withheld precise profit guidance and says it may need more investment.

tone.note: Management was confident on inventory discipline, store availability, franchise growth and the new product pipeline, but cautious on gross margin and profit guidance, and evasive on SSG numbers and brand metrics; analysts probed the volume split, margin trajectory and the decade-long underperformanc
